title: Upload, storage placement, media processing, derivatives, and continuity
objective: Move large media through bounded, portable, recoverable storage and processing authorities without changing source truth.

obligations.title: Ingest enforces path, project, size, type, quota, malware, and durable-finalization boundaries
obligations.residualRisk: Crafted or interrupted uploads can escape storage boundaries, cross tenants, or leave orphaned state.

obligations.title: Storage and processing support backpressure, provider portability, capacity proof, and fault isolation
obligations.residualRisk: Large jobs can exhaust memory, provider quotas, or local disks without bounded queues and portable placement.

obligations.title: Source, derivatives, and manifests satisfy residency, retention, integrity, and restore policy
obligations.residualRisk: Media may be lost, misplaced, or irrecoverable despite a healthy metadata database.
